reason: A Windows-focused compatibility utility that automatically enables Python and pytest temporary-directory use inside the DSH confined shell sandbox by injecting a scoped sitecustomize shim.

summaries.zh: 该插件通过向受限 shell 命令注入 Python 路径 shim，修复 Windows DSH 沙箱中 Python 和 pytest 临时目录的使用问题。
summaries.en: This plugin injects a Python path shim into confined shell commands to make Python and pytest temporary directories work in the Windows DSH sandbox.

capabilities: Modifies the shell executor environment for confined commands
Injects a plugin-provided PYTHONPATH into workspace-write and read-only commands
Patches Python os.mkdir behavior through sitecustomize on Windows
Propagates the shim to child Python processes through PYTHONPATH
